lesson.title: Reviewing an AI-Generated Diff and Verification Evidence
lesson.assistance_level: Direct teaching and guided correction on practice; learner-owned transfer with limited clarification and exact known-answer refinement
lesson.note: Jeremy reviewed a flawed budget-variance change, identified a plausible-but-wrong denominator result, supplied an exact threshold-boundary case, and required revision. In a genuinely different cash-disbursement transfer recovered after a task disconnect, he correctly identified that a missing approved date had been inferred instead of sent to manual review, distorting September cash; he requested inspection of the date-selection rule and explained why row and amount controls were insufficient. Limited assistance clarified targeted inspection and made the exact expected transfer totals explicit. The workbook was not reopened during recovery. Independent mastery and every resume-level capability gate remain unclaimed.
